title: Gate-family ownership v1
description: Validates tests/gates/gate_families.v1.yaml, the mapping from gate-id prefix to the plan that owns that family and to the catalogue section of that plan which FR-P0-REGISTRY compares the family against. A family whose plan cannot be resolved, or whose prefixes overlap another family's, would silently reassign a gate's owner and make the registry agree with a section nobody maintains.

family.description: The family's name. Used in gate output and in FR-P0-REGISTRY's problem codes, never as a path.

id_prefixes.description: Every gate-id prefix this family owns. A registered gate matching no prefix is gate-family-unowned; the longest matching prefix wins, so a family may be carved out of another's range by declaring a longer prefix.

plan_dir.description: The repository-relative folder holding the owning plan. Versioned plans are resolved at this folder's root only; a superseded plan under deprecated/ is never the owner.

plan_stem.description: The plan's filename stem. The owner is <plan_stem>.v<N>.md with the highest N at plan_dir's root.

catalogue_section.description: The numbered section of that plan holding its gate catalogue, in the encoding section 8 of the folder plan fixes. Keyed by heading number, which is why a plan appends a catalogue section rather than renumbering.
